questions.question: Which of the following best describes the structure of benzene?
questions.questionHtml: Which of the following best describes the structure of benzene?

options.text: A branched chain of six carbon atoms
options.html: A branched chain of six carbon atoms

options.text: A five-membered ring with one double bond
options.html: A five-membered ring with one double bond

options.text: A straight chain of six carbon atoms
options.html: A straight chain of six carbon atoms

options.text: A six-membered ring with alternating single and double bonds
options.html: A six-membered ring with alternating single and double bonds

questions.solution:
Explanation:

Benzene (C₆H₆) has a cyclic structure consisting of six carbon atoms forming a ring. Each carbon atom is bonded to one hydrogen atom. The carbon-carbon bonds alternate between single and double bonds, forming a structure known as conjugated π-system, which gives benzene its aromatic stability.

This is often represented as a hexagon with a circle inside, indicating delocalized electrons rather than fixed double bonds.

So, the best description is: A six-membered ring with alternating single and double bonds.

questions.question: Which one of the following statements regarding the Constituent Assembly of India is not correct?
questions.questionHtml: Which one of the following statements regarding the Constituent Assembly of India is not correct?

options.text: The Constituent Assembly was composed of members who had been elected indirectly by the Members of the Provincial Legislative Assembly.
options.html: The Constituent Assembly was composed of members who had been elected indirectly by the Members of the Provincial Legislative Assembly.

options.text: The Constituent Assembly held its first sitting on 9th December, 1946.
options.html: The Constituent Assembly held its first sitting on 9th December, 1946.

options.text: The seats in each province were distributed among the three main communities-Muslim, Sikh and General, in proportion to their respective populations.
options.html: The seats in each province were distributed among the three main communities-Muslim, Sikh and General, in proportion to their respective populations.

options.text: The method of selection in the case of representatives of Indian States was to be determined by the Governor-General of India.
options.html: The method of selection in the case of representatives of Indian States was to be determined by the Governor-General of India.

questions.solution:
Explanation:

A. "The Constituent Assembly was composed of members who had been elected indirectly by the Members of the Provincial Legislative Assembly."
✔️ True. The members were elected by indirect election by the Provincial Legislative Assemblies using single transferable vote in proportional representation.

B. "The Constituent Assembly held its first sitting on 9th December, 1946."
✔️ True. This is a well-documented historical fact.

C. "The seats in each province were distributed among the three main communities—Muslim, Sikh and General, in proportion to their respective populations."
✔️ True. This was part of the framework laid out by the Cabinet Mission Plan of 1946.

D. "The method of selection in the case of representatives of Indian States was to be determined by the Governor-General of India."
❌ False / Not Correct. The method of selection for princely state representatives was to be decided by the rulers of those princely states themselves, not by the Governor-General.
